purpose: Deepen VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION and BOUNDARY_TRANSLATION using real Xuzhou enterprise requests where some evidence already exists but the receiving authority/counterparty still cannot act on it. Do not infer a consulting market from unresolved requests.

evidence: A Xuzhou enterprise reported a power outage after the utility attributed a grid impact to enterprise electrical equipment and required professional inspection before restoration.
The enterprise used a third-party inspection organization and no fault point was found, yet the utility still had not restored power at the time of the published request.
findings.interpretation: The business did obtain a technical verification artifact, but that artifact did not yet satisfy the decision-owner's acceptance condition. This is not proof that more inspection supply is missing.
findings.unknown: The public request stream does not expose the final resolution or which evidence/standard/coordination step ultimately unlocked restoration.

evidence: A Xuzhou enterprise reported six imported pressure vessels that could not be registered because the available factory inspection certificates did not meet domestic safety-technical-specification requirements.
findings.interpretation: Evidence existed, but provenance/content/standard compatibility was insufficient for the receiving regulatory workflow. The missing element is accepted evidence, not the mere existence of a certificate.
findings.unknown: The final remediation path is not publicly exposed in the request stream.

evidence: A Xuzhou enterprise reported that a bank would not execute an overseas-project funds remittance because the filed/verified record did not reflect the in-kind-investment structure actually involved.
The enterprise sought to change the in-kind portion to monetary funds because the representation mismatch blocked the transaction.
findings.interpretation: The connection was blocked by inconsistent state representation across enterprise filing, regulatory record and bank execution logic—not by absence of capital or bank transfer capability.

evidence: The Jiangsu Inspection and Testing Regulation requires reports to identify sample acquisition, test basis, data/results, authorized signer, institution seal and applicable qualification marks, and regulates subcontracting/record retention.

2025 national supervision results published in 2026 found reports that were false/untrue, outside recognized capability scope, used expired qualification, lacked proper signatures/seals, or violated required methods/data handling.

The 2026 national one-list/one-database rule limits when CMA qualification marks can be used and explicitly distinguishes tests that may be technically performed from reports that carry formal qualification effect.
findings.interpretation: Evidence acceptance is not binary evidence/no-evidence. Provenance, scope, method, identity, qualification, standard and responsibility chain determine whether an artifact can enter the receiver's decision process.

search_rules_refined.name: EVIDENCE_ACCEPTANCE_GAP
search_rules_refined.pattern: evidence exists + receiving decision owner still cannot rely/act -> inspect acceptance schema before hypothesizing more supply
questions: Who is the actual decision owner that must accept the evidence?
What exact standard, scope, provenance, identity, qualification or format makes evidence admissible/actionable to that actor?
Was the evidence produced by an actor recognized for this exact decision purpose?
Does the receiving actor require a different test basis, authorized signer, chain of custody, account/filing state or regulatory mapping?
What was the last accepted artifact in a successful comparable case?
search_rules_refined.relationship_to_existing_doctrine: Deepening of VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION and BOUNDARY_TRANSLATION; not a new top-level ontology.

search_rules_refined.name: VERIFICATION_NE_ACCEPTANCE
search_rules_refined.pattern: technically plausible result/certificate/report != receiver-recognized decision evidence

search_rules_refined.name: CROSS_SYSTEM_STATE_CONSISTENCY
search_rules_refined.pattern: enterprise reality + regulator filing + bank/platform/utility decision state must describe the same transaction/resource in mutually compatible terms before the flow can continue
